groups.label: Product direction

slots.SUBJECT: Product direction
slots.CORE IDEA: many competing options collapsing into one chosen path
slots.ACTION OR TRANSFORMATION: alignment of competing planes toward a single orange decision node

groups.prompt: Create an original isometric system-object illustration for “Product direction”. Show several competing interface planes and stacked tiles collapsing and aligning toward one shared active decision node. Use a consistent 30-degree isometric view, a centered assembly, bone-white hardware, graphite interiors, fine dark outlines, subtle paper grain, and one signal-orange decision node. The architecture should feel understandable rather than futuristic: precise, modular, tactile, and human. Warm paper background (#F4EEDF) with generous negative space. Occupies about 65–75% of the canvas. No text, logos, code, glassmorphism, glossy plastic, cyberpunk styling, clutter, or decorative components without meaning.
